title: Longest Day/Night Clock
description: Enchant a clock to make days and nights last longer — a rare treasure from shipwrecks
body:
# Longest Day/Night Clock

Ever felt like the Minecraft day is just too short? Not enough time to build, farm, or explore before the sun drops? This mod gives the humble Clock a reason to exist.

## Tidewatch Enchantment

Find a **Tidewatch** enchanted book and apply it to any Clock. While that enchanted clock sits in your inventory, the entire day/night cycle slows down — for **both day and night**.

| Level | Effect |
|-------|--------|
| Tidewatch I | Days & nights last **2×** longer |
| Tidewatch II | Days & nights last **3×** longer |
| Tidewatch III | Days & nights last **4×** longer |

Longer days for building and farming. Longer nights for mob farms and XP. Your call.

## How to get it

Tidewatch is a **treasure enchantment** — you can't roll it at an enchanting table or buy it from villagers. The only way to find it is inside **shipwreck treasure chests**. Go dig up some sunken loot.

- Tidewatch I — 10% chance
- Tidewatch II — 8% chance
- Tidewatch III — 5% chance

## The rules

- **Keep it in your inventory** — the clock only works while carried in your main inventory or offhand. Tuck it inside a Shulker Box and the effect switches off.
- **Levels don't stack or combine** — an anvil won't merge two Tidewatch clocks into a higher level. What you find is what you get.
- **Highest level wins** — on a multiplayer world, the strongest active Tidewatch among all players sets the pace for everyone. Want it gone? Take it from whoever's carrying it.
- **Death has a cost:**
  - With **keepInventory off** (default) — the clock drops on the ground like your other items. Anyone can grab it.
  - With **keepInventory on** — the clock is **destroyed** instead of being kept. On worlds where death normally costs you nothing, this one item still slips through your fingers.

## Compatibility

Forge 1.20.1. Works client and server (install on both). No config needed — drop it in and play.

---

*Some who peek under the hood with item-inspection mods may notice this clock answers to another name.*
